FAQ

Questions we get asked.

Straight answers. No hedging.

How much does a project cost?+
Every quote is fixed price, written down, agreed before anything starts. A simple landing page is typically a few hundred euros. A custom web app or AI tool can range from low four figures up depending on scope. We don't bill by the hour — you know exactly what you're paying for before we start.
How long does it take?+
Most projects ship in 1–2 weeks. Landing pages can be live in 48 hours. Bigger web apps with multi-user logins, billing, and custom logic typically take 3–6 weeks. We tell you a realistic timeline upfront and stick to it.
Who owns the code and the data?+
You do. Full source code, deployment access, and any data the system holds is handed over on delivery. No licensing fees, no vendor lock-in, no "we host it for you forever or it disappears" trap.
What if I'm not happy with the result?+
Every project includes a review phase before launch. You test it, give feedback, we iterate — all within the fixed price. We don't consider a project done until you say it is.
Do you offer ongoing support?+
Yes — a simple monthly retainer covers hosting, SSL, updates, and priority support. One message and we're on it. No tickets, no call centres, no three-day waits.
Are you GDPR compliant?+
Yes. Everything we build follows GDPR by default — minimal data collection, encrypted in transit and at rest, clear data export and deletion paths. We also help you write the privacy policy and DPA if you don't have one yet.
Can you work with my existing site or system?+
Usually yes — WordPress, Squarespace, Webflow, custom builds, internal tools. We can extend what you've got rather than rebuild from scratch when that's the right call. We'll be honest with you about which path actually makes sense.
What does the first conversation look like?+
30-minute call. You tell us the problem, we ask questions. By the end of it you'll know whether software is the right answer at all — and if it is, roughly what it'd cost and how long it'd take. No sales pitch. No obligation.
